notes.title: Patch Notes for June 17, 2024
notes.notes:
- Added support for different game versions when hosting a multiplayer server
- Fixed bug with in-game shop items for Windows 64-bit version

notes.title: Update 1.6.9
notes.notes:
[b]Update 1.6.9[/b] introduces the Operation Editor, an in-game tool that lets you create your own missions!

[h1]Operation Editor[/h1]
Create your own missions with the new Operation Editor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40197790/670a2f2b259a461bbe87bfa75eae33a8666f0b18.png[/img] 

The editor is integrated with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1131080/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url], allowing you to share your own missions or browse community missions.

Check out the guide here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3214649587

[h1]Other Notes[/h1]
- [b]Motion Sensors[/b] and [b]Jammers[/b] can now be thrown
- Added [b]Napalm[/b] attachment for Shotguns
- Added new hero: [b]Agent 1237[/b]
- New character animations for NPCs
- UI and music updates
- Performance optimizations

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Remember to [url=https://discord.com/invite/9Ghmd2bb]join the official Discord server[/url], now with a dedicated Operation Editor channel!

notes.title: Update 1.6.7
notes.notes:
[b]Update 1.6.7[/b] brings a lot of new content to Deadswitch 3, including 2 new maps!

[h3]Downturn Extended[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40197790/d16c6a1ab99744e743a50793ea972e27fc87dc33.png[/img]
Tactical map expanded from the original Downturn!

[h3]Battleship[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40197790/110ac2a026f15d248aa1ec66714cdb062aa122ed.png[/img]
Massive battleship with multiple vertical levels!

[h3]Promo Codes[/h3]
Promo codes are now supported in Deadswitch 3. 
Go to [b]Ranked > Profile > Redeem Code[/b] to redeem a promo code.

[h3]Other Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New challenges
[*] Slightly increased sprint and crouch movement speed
[*] Increased default number of bots from 5 to 7 (local play)
[*] Reduced lobby timers from 30 to 15 seconds (multiplayer)
[*] Chat text is now also displayed above each player (multiplayer)
[*] Performance optimizations
[*] Lots of UI updates
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
